# wsmedia: media_open joins an away phone to a dahua_sip ring
## configure: the Capabilities struct, then driver_availability
  {"id":1,"result":{"DirectCapable":true,"HasRelay":true,"InboundAudio":0,"OutboundAudio":0,"RTSPTemplate":"rtsp://{host}/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=1","ReportsAvailability":true}}
    raw='{"id":1,"result":{"InboundAudio":0,"OutboundAudio":0,"DirectCapable":true,"HasRelay":true,"RTSPTemplate":"rtsp://{host}/cam/realmonitor?channel=1\\u0026subtype=1","ReportsAvailability":true}}'
  {"method":"driver_availability","params":{"available":true,"device_id":"127.0.0.9","reason":""}}
    raw='{"method":"driver_availability","params":{"device_id":"127.0.0.9","available":true,"reason":""}}'
## registered: True
## station gets the 180: SIP/2.0 180 Ringing | CSeq 1 INVITE | To <sip:8001@127.0.0.9>;tag=<TAG>
## ringing
  {"method":"ringing","params":{"call_id":"ring-w1","device_id":"127.0.0.9"}}
## the VTO is not answered before the leg exists: ''
## media_open pcmu
  {"id":2,"result":{"codec":"pcmu","frame_bytes":320,"frame_ms":40}}
## station gets the 200 at once: SIP/2.0 200 OK
## its SDP: v=0 / o=portico 0 0 IN IP4 127.0.0.1 / s=portico / c=IN IP4 127.0.0.1 / t=0 0 / m=audio <RTP> RTP/AVP 96 / a=rtpmap:96 L16/16000 / a=ptime:40 / 
## media_open again
  {"error":{"code":"already_open","message":"ring-w1"},"id":3}
    raw='{"id":3,"error":{"code":"already_open","message":"ring-w1"}}'
## the VTO's audio reaches Python as media_frame (320 bytes of mu-law)
  {"method":"media_frame","params":{"call_id":"ring-w1","d":""}}
  {"method":"media_frame","params":{"call_id":"ring-w1","d":""}}
  {"method":"media_frame","params":{"call_id":"ring-w1","d":""}}
## media_frame x4
  {"id":10,"result":{"ok":true}}
  {"id":11,"result":{"ok":true}}
  {"id":12,"result":{"ok":true}}
  {"id":13,"result":{"ok":true}}
## RTP at the station (payload type, bytes, md5): [(96, 1280, '256dd509eb52ac5cb0969b2b4c22a0a3')]
## media_close (notification then response)
  {"method":"media_closed","params":{"call_id":"ring-w1","reason":"user"}}
  {"id":20,"result":{"ok":true}}
## station gets the BYE of the closed leg: BYE sip:127.0.0.9 SIP/2.0 | CSeq 1 BYE | To <sip:vto@127.0.0.9>;tag=a
## media_frame after close
  {"error":{"code":"unknown_session","message":"ring-w1"},"id":21}
    raw='{"id":21,"error":{"code":"unknown_session","message":"ring-w1"}}'
## station gets the 180: SIP/2.0 180 Ringing | CSeq 1 INVITE | To <sip:8001@127.0.0.9>;tag=<TAG>
## ringing
  {"method":"ringing","params":{"call_id":"ring-w2","device_id":"127.0.0.9"}}
## media_open l16
  {"id":30,"result":{"codec":"l16","frame_bytes":1280,"frame_ms":40}}
## station gets the 200: SIP/2.0 200 OK
## station gets the BYE answered: SIP/2.0 200 OK | CSeq 2 BYE | To <sip:8001@127.0.0.9>;tag=b
## call_state_changed ended (the VTO hung up)
  {"method":"call_state_changed","params":{"call_id":"ring-w2","device_id":"127.0.0.9","state":"ended"}}
## a frame after the VTO hung up is still accepted
  {"id":31,"result":{"ok":true}}
## media_close
  {"method":"media_closed","params":{"call_id":"ring-w2","reason":"closed"}}
  {"id":32,"result":{"ok":true}}
  exit code: 0
